clause_locators.span: هُوَ الْخَيْرُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ.
قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ: قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ: فَإِنَّ نَاسًا يَزْعُمون أَنَّهُ نَهْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ؟
فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ: النَّهْرُ الَّذِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ إِيَّاهُ.
It is the good which Allah gave to him (the Prophet).
Abu Bishr said, "I said to Sa`id bin Jubayr, `Verily, people are claiming that it is a river in Paradise.
Sa`id replied, `The river which is in Paradise is part of the goodness which Allah gave him.

proposed_atomic_scopes.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports Ibn Abbas's explanation of al-Kawthar as the good, also worded abundant good, given to the Prophet.

proposed_atomic_scopes.speaker: Sa'id ibn Jubayr
proposed_atomic_scopes.statement_en: In reply to Abu Bishr, Sa'id ibn Jubayr says the river in Paradise is part of the good given to the Prophet.
